microprocessor.name: Sharps Modular ECU V4E - Full controller + screen

node.label: Cylinder Data
node.description: Connect to any cylinder, Engine will not run without this

node.label: starter motors
node.description: For electric starters, can delete if not needed

node.label: Auxilery clutch, alternators etc
node.description: sets to 1 when ECU is on,

node.label: fans
node.description: Turns fans on at set temp

node.label: screen, only visualizes data. Not needed
Engine on/off
node.description: Toggle/key button, dont forget cylinder composite data

node.label: Monitor touch, only visualizes data. Not needed
Electric pumps
node.description: Anything you want to be on when engine is turned on

node.label: Main Clutch
node.description: This is the clutch to give power to your wheels, props,gen etc. ignore if you dont need it

node.label: Throttle
node.description: The input signal to be processed.

node.label: Starter
node.description: The input signal to be processed.

node.label: Gen, For calculations for display when using as generator
Composite Data Out
node.description: Check Lua block / description for channel allocation

object.script:
m=math pi=m.pi si=m.sin co=m.cos fl=m.floor gn=input.getNumber gb=input.getBool sf=string.format
function IPIR(X,Y,W,H) return tx>X and ty>Y and tx<X+W and ty<Y+H end function tog(x,z) if x and not y then z=not z end y=x return z end
rt=0 rps_T=property.getBool("Default Engine Speed Unit")
function onTick() tx,ty=gn(3),gn(4) temp,rps,AF,LOAD,D_rps,M_rps,bat,lit,cap,ls,gen,d_t,bs=gn(10),gn(11),gn(12),gn(13)*100,gn(15),gn(16),gn(17),gn(18),gn(19),gn(20),gn(21),gn(22),gn(23) fp=lit/cap
th=gb(1) ck=th2 and not th d_rps=gb(12) and D_rps or 0 m_rps=gb(13) and M_rps or 60
rps_T=tog(IPIR(8,8,16,5)and ck,rps_T) fuel_m=tog(IPIR(fuel_m and 3 or 21,35,12,20)and ck,fuel_m)and not batt_m batt_m=tog(IPIR(3,35,12,20)and ck,batt_m)and not fuel_m
if gb(10) then cc="standby"elseif gb(9) then cc="engine off"elseif gb(6) then cc="HIGH TEMP"elseif rps<2.5 then cc="LOW RPS"elseif bat<0.6 then cc="low batt"elseif fp<=0.1 then cc="low fuel"else cc="ALL GOOD"end
rt=rps>2 and rt+1/60 or rt rh=fl(rt/3600) rm=fl(rt/60)-rh*60 rs=rt-rm*60 th2=gb(1) end
pt=property.getText bgr=pt("Background RGB") tex=pt("Text") tit=pt("Title") it=pt("Instrument text") wb=pt("Warn bad") db=pt("Dial dash") dn=pt("Needle") dlt=pt("Dial limit") fb=pt("Fuel border") ff=pt("Fuel fill") tb=pt("Temp border") tf=pt("Temp fill") tn=tonumber function col(C,A) c={C:match("(%d+).-(%d+).-(%d+)")} f=A~=nil and A or 255 r=tn(c[1])or 0 g=tn(c[2])or 0 b=tn(c[3])or 0 s.setColor(r^2.2/255^2.2*r,g^2.2/255^2.2*g,b^2.2/255^2.2*b,f) end
s=screen dt,dtb,dl,dr,drf,dtf=s.drawText,s.drawTextBox,s.drawLine,s.drawRect,s.drawRectF,s.drawTriangleF function onDraw() col(bgr)drf(0,0,96,96) col(tit)drf(33,0,53,7)dtf(84,7,99,0,84,0) col(bgr)dt(35,1,"Sharps ECU") col(bgr,100)dl(33,7,33,31)dl(0,31,96,31) col((cc=="ALL GOOD"or cc=="standby"or cc=="engine off") and tit or wb)dt(35,9,cc) col(tex)dt(35,17,sf("A/F:%.1f",AF))dt(35,25,sf("load:%.0f",LOAD).."%") t_t=tog(IPIR(82,25,25,8)and ck,t_t) temp_bar(95,27,temp,t_t and sf("%.0f^",d_t) or sf("%.0fC",temp)) dial(16,16,rps_T and sf("%.0f",rps*60)or sf("%.1f",rps),rps_T and"RPM"or"RPS",rps,d_rps,m_rps)
if not fuel_m then batt(2,55,bat) end
if batt_m then col(tit) dt(22,33,"battery info") col(tex) dt(22,41,sf("%.0f ",bs).."% / min") dt(22,49,sf("%.0f swatts",gen)) dt(22,57,sf("%.0f s // l/s",m.abs(gen/ls))) end
if not batt_m then fx=fuel_m and 22 or 39 sm=tog(IPIR(fx,41,64,5)and ck,sm) col(tex) dt(fx,41,sm and sf("%.2f",ls).."L/S" or sf("%.0f",ls*60).."L/MIN")
if fuel_m then col(tit) dt(22,33,"fuel info") col(tex) dt(22,49,sf("%.0f L",lit)) t_f=m.abs(lit/ls) f_hr=fl(t_f/3600) f_min=fl(t_f/60)-f_hr*60 f_e=" empty"
if m.abs(ls)>0.05 then dt(22,57,t_f>3600 and sf("%.0f h %.0f m",f_hr,f_min)..f_e or sf("%.0f m",f_min)..f_e) end fuel(2,55,fp) end end
if not fuel_m and not batt_m then col(tit) dt(39,33,"consumption") dt(39,49,"run time") col(tex) dt(39,57,rh>0 and sf("%.0f hr %.0f m",rh,rm)or sf("%.0f min %.0f s",rm,rs))fuel(21,55,fp)col(bgr,100)dl(37,32,37,64) else col(bgr,100) dl(20,32,20,64) end end
function batt(a,b,c)col(ff,100)drf(a,b,12,-20*c)col(fb)dr(a,b,12,-20)drf(a+3,b-20,7,-2)col(it)dt(a-2,b+2,sf("%.0f",c*100).."%") end function fuel(a,b,c)col(ff,100)drf(a,b,12,-20*c)col(fb)dr(a,b,12,-20)drf(a+3,b-15,7,-3)dr(a+12,b-15,2,15)col(it)dt(a,b+2,sf("%.0f",c*100).."%") end function dial(a,b,c,d,e,f,g) NA=pi*7/4+e*pi*1.5/g SNA=pi*7/4+f*pi*1.5/g col(it)dtb(a-16,b-1,32,5,c,0,0)dtb(a-8,b-7,16,5,d,0,0)for h=0,-pi/4,-1/23 do col(dlt)dl(a+14*co(h),b-14*si(h),a+16*co(h),b-16*si(h))end col(db)for h=pi*5/4,-pi/3,-pi/4 do dl(a+13*co(h),b-13*si(h),a+16*co(h),b-16*si(h))end for h=pi*5/4,-pi/3,-pi/12 do dl(a+15*co(h),b-15*si(h),a+16*co(h),b-16*si(h))end col(dn)dl(a-9*co(NA),b-9*si(NA),a-16*co(NA),b-16*si(NA))col(dn,100)dl(a-12*co(SNA),b-12*si(SNA),a-16*co(SNA),b-16*si(SNA)) end function temp_bar(a,b,c,d)col(tb)for i=2,4 do dl(a-9,b-4*i,a-8,b-4*i)dl(a-3,b-4*i,a-2,b-4*i)end;dl(a-9,b-20,a-2,b-20)dl(a-9,b-4,a-2,b-4)drf(a-13,b-3,3,-2)dl(a-12,b-5,a-12,b-11)dl(a-11,b-9,a-10,b-9)dl(a-11,b-7,a-10,b-7)col(tf)drf(a-8,b-4,5,-(c/120)*16)col(it)dtb(a-21,b-2,21,8,d,1)end

gn=input.getNumber gb=input.getBool sb=output.setBool sn=output.setNumber
function onTick() -------------------------------------------------------------list of on/off composite channels that is outputted sb(1,not gb(9))--engine running sb(2,gb(7))--starter on sb(3,gb(6))--high temp sb(4,gb(11))--critical temp triggered sb(5,gb(12))--RPS based throttle sb(6,gb(13))-- Max rps limit on
-------------------------------------------------------------list of number composite channels that is outputted sn(1,gn(11))--actual rps sn(2,gn(15))--desired rps sn(3,gn(10))--temp sn(4,gn(13))--load 0-100% sn(5,(2^round((8/1)*gn(13),1))-1)--load for radial segment set to bits sn(6,gn(12))--AFR sn(7,gn(20))--fuel consumption sn(8,gn(18))--current fuel level sn(9,gn(17))--battery sn(10,(2^round((8/1)*gn(17),1))-1)--battery sn(11,gn(21))-- Gen Swatts sn(12,gn(21)/gn(20))-- Swatts // Litres/second sn(13,gn(11)*60)--actual rpm sn(14,gn(15)*60)--desired rpm sn(15,(gn(18)/gn(19))*100) -- fuel 0-100 % sn(16,gn(22)) -- delta temp change per min
------------------------------------------------------------ screen controller specific sn(17,gn(24))--max rps sn(18,gn(25))--raw fuel cylinder end
------------------------------------------------------------ Ignore Below
function round(x,y) return y*math.floor((x+y/2)/y) end
